style: gentle bedtime lullaby for toddlers, soft warm female vocal, slow and calm, music box, soft piano, harp, light strings, dreamy, sleepy, clear gentle diction, vocals start immediately on the very first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short outro
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Rock-a-bye baby, on the treetop,
When the wind blows, the cradle will rock,
Hush now, little one, snuggle in tight,
Rock-a-bye baby, sleep through the night.

[Verse 1]
The moon is rising, silver and round,
The stars are twinkling without a sound,
Bunny is yawning, lamb is too,
Teddy is sleepy, and so are you.

[Chorus]
Rock-a-bye baby, on the treetop,
When the wind blows, the cradle will rock,
Hush now, little one, snuggle in tight,
Rock-a-bye baby, sleep through the night.

[Verse 2]
Gentle breezes whisper low,
Swaying branches, soft and slow,
Owl says hoo from the tall oak tree,
Close your eyes and dream with me.

[Bridge]
Breathe in slowly, one, two, three,
Breathe out softly, calm and free,
Wiggle your toes and let them rest,
Snuggle down, you're the very best.

[Verse 3]
Luna is watching from up above,
Wrapping the world in a blanket of love,
Morning will come with the shining sun,
Sleep now, sleep now, little one.

[Chorus]
Rock-a-bye baby, on the treetop,
When the wind blows, the cradle will rock,
Hush now, little one, snuggle in tight,
Rock-a-bye baby, sleep through the night.

[Outro]
Rock-a-bye baby. Goodnight.

meta.title: Rock-a-bye Baby 🌙 Lullaby for Babies & Kids | Moonbeam
meta.description:
Rock-a-bye Baby, the classic lullaby with gentle new verses. Luna, Bunny, Lamb and Teddy get sleepy as the moon rises and the stars twinkle.
Soft music box, harp and slow breathing to help little ones fall asleep. Ages 0-6.
